title: French parliament passes fast-fashion law to curb Shein and Temu
summary: France's Senate ⁠passed a bill on Monday aimed at curbing online fast-fashion retailers ​such as Shein, Temu and AliExpress, after more than two years of debate and discussion between the ​upper ‌and lower houses of parliament.
